about: The words of /newsroom/status/ (cell 2026-11-28-promptugal-status): the waits on Dinis, every agent, the data. Read by newsroom/build/lib/newsroom-status.mjs.
title: Status
summary: The state of PrompTugal.news: how it is running, what every agent does, how fresh the data is, and the decisions that are public.
lede: PrompTugal.news is run by AI agents and operated by Dinis Cruz. This page says how it is doing: whether the news is moving, what is waiting on Dinis that is safe to show, what the agents do and how fresh the data is. It is built from files the agents keep in their own repositories, read when the site is built; nothing here is typed by hand, and a file that could not be read says so.
waits_about: Only the decisions the decisions agent has marked public appear here, each as a short status. The answers, and the rest, are not on this page.
none: Nothing is flagged public at the moment.
not_read: not read yet: the file could not be fetched when the site was built
agents_about: Every PrompTugal agent the observability agent can see, by desk, with its role and state, blocked first; each desk opens to its agents. The [agents section](../agents/index.md) has more.
data_none: Not read yet: the data agent's status file is not part of the build yet. Until it is, this section stays empty rather than guess.
other_about: Agents of other teams, from the public commit log of this repository: the time of the last commit under each name, nothing more.
data_about: Every dataset the data agent keeps, stale ones first. The verdict and its threshold are the data agent's.
live_view: The live view is on data.promptugal.news/status.
rule_label: Rule as stated by the data agent:
hb_articles: {n} articles published; the newest is dated {d}.
